nieuw.titel: Build infantry to more than double a dragon's unit strength
nieuw.tekst: For an infantry block intended to face a dragon, aim to retain more than twice its unit strength after the challenge. He describes a champion and roughly 25 infantry as making this relatively easy to achieve.

nieuw.waarom: He explains that a unit champion outside the fighting rank cannot move through the ranks to accept the challenge.
